## 2. Statutory Foundations & Regulatory References
- Reserve Bank of India (RBI): Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2016 (Updated for FY 2026-27).
- Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC): Section 16(1) of the DICGC Act, 1961. Limit: ₹5,00,000 per depositor per insured bank (both principal and interest in same right and capacity).
- Income Tax Act, 1961:
  - Section 80TTB: Deduction in respect of interest on deposits in case of senior citizens (resident aged 60+), maximum ₹50,000 per financial year.
  - Section 80TTA: Up to ₹10,000 on savings account interest for non-senior citizens.
  - Section 194A: TDS on interest from banking company (threshold ₹50,000 for seniors, ₹40,000 for others).
  - Form 15H: Rule 29C(1A) of Income Tax Rules, 1962 for senior citizens with estimated zero tax liability.
  - Section 10(15)(iv)(h): Complete tax exemption for interest on notified tax-free bonds (e.g. NHAI, REC, PFC).
  - Section 54EC: Capital gains tax exemption on long-term capital assets invested in notified bonds (REC, PFC, IRFC) up to ₹50 Lakhs.

## 4. WebMCP Tools Integration
Endpoints:
- POST https://yieldnest.online/api/mcp/tools
  Parameters: `tool`, `params`
  Examples:
  - `{ "tool": "search_debt_instruments", "params": { "is_senior_citizen": true, "min_rate": 8.0 } }`
  - `{ "tool": "calculate_fd_yield", "params": { "principal": 500000, "rate_percent": 8.2, "tenure_months": 60, "is_senior_citizen": true, "tax_bracket_percent": 30 } }`
  - `{ "tool": "get_statutory_rates" }`
